text:
Matvei Gridin, the 28th pick in 2024, is 20 years old and already playing almost 16 minutes a night for Calgary, up more than two over his last ten games. He has 11 points in 18 games, including a two-goal night against Toronto in October.

That pace stands out against his draft class. Forwards picked 23rd to 33rd since 2005 scored a median 0.35 points a game in their first full season, and fewer than half reached 200 NHL games. Gridin is at 0.61. The finishing is a little high (5 goals on 3.1 expected), so expect his rate to settle somewhere closer to our projection of about 51 points.

What makes him interesting is how he moves the puck. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking, on a small sample of 8 games, had him carrying it in on 61% of his entries and exiting with possession 65% of the time. He is also among the league's fastest skaters by NHL Edge bursts. Evolving-Hockey noted he played with weak teammates last season. He looks better with better ones.
headline: Gridin is ahead of schedule in Calgary
